title: Teenage Alberino finds the Book of Enoch at Borders

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, remembers driving to a Borders bookstore at about 16 and browsing the shelves. He says that is where he found the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text left out of most Bibles, among the Pseudepigrapha, old writings credited to biblical figures. He tells it as the moment his interest in these old stories began.
